\section[māṅṅa]{\ml{മാങ്ങ} (māṅṅa) — a mango}

\label{lesson:ML-C133-mango}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for puttu, then the Malayalam for a curry.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{മാങ്ങ}}
\textbf{\ml{മാങ്ങ}} (\emph{māṅṅa}) — \textquotedblleft{}a mango\textquotedblright{}, a \textbf{\ml{പഴം}} from the tree in the \textbf{\ml{മുറ്റം}}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The summer fruit.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{māṅṅa}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{māṅṅa}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{māṅṅa}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for puttu, then the Malayalam for a curry, then say \emph{māṅṅa} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{മാങ്ങ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A mango\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
